title: STAB: Specification-driven Testing for Algorithmic Bottlenecks
abstract: arXiv:2605.27981v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Evaluating the efficiency of algorithmic code requires test cases that expose runtime bottlenecks. Previous methods generate efficiency test cases either by increasing input size or by generating code-specific inputs that make the given implementation run slowly. Consequently, they do not address the structural input conditions that drive the algorithmic worst case. We introduce STAB, a specification-driven pipeline that generates test cases that expose algorithmic bottlenecks from a natural-language problem specification alone. STAB separates the task into constraint-bound maximization and adversarial structure injection. (i) The constraint saturator extracts constraints and resolves large admissible size assignments using rule-based saturation and CP-SAT optimization over related variables. translated_title: STAB：面向算法瓶颈的规格驱动测试
translated_abstract: 评估算法代码的效率需要能够暴露运行时瓶颈的测试用例。以往的方法要么通过增大输入规模来生成效率测试用例，要么通过生成使给定实现运行缓慢的代码特定输入来生成效率测试用例。因此，这些方法未能处理驱动算法最坏情况的输入结构条件。我们提出了STAB，一个仅凭自然语言问题规格即可生成暴露算法瓶颈的测试用例的规格驱动流水线。STAB将任务分解为约束边界最大化与对抗性结构注入两部分：(i) 约束饱和器提取约束条件，并通过基于规则的饱和操作以及利用CP-SAT对相关变量进行的优化，求解大规模可容许的尺寸赋值；(ii) 对抗性场景注入器从经过精心整理的场景目录中检索实现层面的对抗性构造原则……
tldr: STAB是一个规格驱动的测试生成流水线，仅凭自然语言问题描述，通过约束饱和最大化与对抗性结构注入两个环节，即可自动生成能够暴露算法最坏情况运行瓶颈的测试用例。
en_tdlr: STAB is a specification-driven pipeline that generates test cases exposing algorithmic worst-case bottlenecks solely from natural-language problem specifications, by combining constraint-bound maximization with adversarial structure injection.
